use magnus::prelude::*;

mod core_types {
    #[derive(Debug)]
    pub enum GraphQLError { Shared, GraphOnly }
    #[derive(Debug)]
    pub enum SchemaError { Shared, SchemaOnly }
    impl std::fmt::Display for GraphQLError {
        fn fmt(&self, output: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result { output.write_str("graphql") }
    }
    impl std::fmt::Display for SchemaError {
        fn fmt(&self, output: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result { output.write_str("schema") }
    }
    impl GraphQLError { pub fn status_code(&self) -> u16 { 403 } }
    impl SchemaError {
        pub fn status_code(&self) -> u16 { 429 }
        pub fn error_type(&self) -> String { "schema-kind".into() }
    }
}

// CONVERTERS

fn graph_shared() -> Result<(), magnus::Error> {
    Err(graph_ql_error_to_magnus_err(core_types::GraphQLError::Shared))
}
fn graph_only() -> Result<(), magnus::Error> {
    Err(graph_ql_error_to_magnus_err(core_types::GraphQLError::GraphOnly))
}
fn schema_shared() -> Result<(), magnus::Error> {
    Err(schema_error_to_magnus_err(core_types::SchemaError::Shared))
}
fn schema_only() -> Result<(), magnus::Error> {
    Err(schema_error_to_magnus_err(core_types::SchemaError::SchemaOnly))
}

#[magnus::init]
fn init(ruby: &magnus::Ruby) -> Result<(), magnus::Error> {
    let module = ruby.define_module("RubyFamilyNative")?;
    // REGISTRATIONS
    module.define_singleton_method("graph_shared", magnus::function!(graph_shared, 0))?;
    module.define_singleton_method("graph_only", magnus::function!(graph_only, 0))?;
    module.define_singleton_method("schema_shared", magnus::function!(schema_shared, 0))?;
    module.define_singleton_method("schema_only", magnus::function!(schema_only, 0))?;
    Ok(())
}
